description: Invite a new guest to the workspace. Requires email address.

can_create_views.description: Permission: whether the guest can create views.

can_edit_tags.description: Permission: whether the guest can edit tags.

can_see_time_estimated.description: Permission: whether the guest can see time estimated.

can_see_time_spent.description: Permission: whether the guest can see time spent.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.
